_about: Hedge sentences for the hedge-only control (scripts/hedge_rewrite.py). One sentence from each slot is added to a neutral reply; the reply itself is kept word for word. Each slot mirrors one instruction in hedge_hack_system.txt. None of the sentences says which way the evidence points.
